Kiierr’s Advanced Laser Technology

While iRestore combines LEDs & laser diodes in their devices, Kiierr caps use PureLaser™ Technology which exclusively uses high-quality medical grader laser diodes. Laser diodes are clinically proven to be more effective for stimulating hair follicles and promoting hair growth compared to LEDs.

Additionally, Kiierr understands the importance of convenience in your daily routine. Kiierr Treatments are only 6 minutes daily for the 302 MD model and iRestore Treatments are 12 minutes daily for the Elite model.

With Kiierr, you can achieve the same, if not better, results in half the time, allowing you to seamlessly integrate hair restoration into your busy schedule.

Kiierr’s Superior Value

Kiierr offers top-tier hair restoration technology at a significantly more affordable price point. The Kiierr 302 MD starts at $1699.

Although the iRestore Elite does sometimes have sales, the starting price on their website is $2499.

Not only is Kiierr more affordable, but it also provides more laser diodes, enhancing the overall effectiveness and value of your investment.

SHOP KIIERR

The Problem with iRestore

When considering a hair restoration device, it’s important to evaluate customer experiences alongside the advertised claims. Some iRestore users have shared concerns about their results after extended use, challenges with customer support, and dissatisfaction with return policies and hidden fees. While no company or product is perfect, understanding these experiences can help you make a more informed decision when choosing the right device for your needs.

Why Are Laser Diodes Superior to LEDs?

Medical-grade laser diodes are clinically proven to deliver coherent and focused light that penetrates deeply into the scalp, effectively stimulating hair follicles and promoting regrowth. In contrast, LEDs emit a broader, non-coherent light that disperses widely and penetrates less deeply, making them less effective for precise follicle stimulation.

Combination devices that use both laser diodes and LEDs may also dilute the intensity of the laser light, potentially compromising the focused therapeutic effects of the diodes for the sake of broader coverage.

Research consistently shows that devices relying solely on laser diodes yield better hair restoration results.

With more laser diodes for targeted hair follicle stimulation, shorter treatment times, and unparalleled comfort, Kiierr delivers a superior hair restoration experience that prioritizes both effectiveness & convenience, helping you achieve visible results faster & with greater ease.

We’re so confident you’ll see results in just 7 months that we offer a Risk Free 100% Money-Back Guarantee option (see policy for details), unlike iRestore, which requires you to wait a full year & charges an 18% service fee.

When it comes to restoring your hair & confidence, Kiierr is the trusted choice that delivers results you can count on!
